tools.description: Aggregate counts for many brains in one round trip. Pass a comma-separated `ids` list; brains the caller cannot access are omitted rather than erroring. Returns dictionary. Requires authentication.

ids.description: Comma-separated brain ids, e.g. `ids=a,b,c`. Unowned ids are omitted.

tools.name: brains_bulk_stats
tools.title: Bulk brain stats

tools.description: Create a new brain for the calling subject. A brain is an isolated knowledge vault: every capture, page, and connection belongs to exactly one brain. The `x-subject-id` header determines who owns it. Returns briefSettings, createdAt, description. Requires body and authentication.
tools.name: brains_create
tools.title: Create a brain

tools.description: Retrieve a single brain by ID, including its name, description, and brief settings. Returns briefSettings, createdAt, description. Requires brainId and authentication.
tools.name: brains_get
tools.title: Get a brain

tools.description: List every brain owned by the calling subject, most recently updated first. Returns array. Requires authentication.
tools.name: brains_list
tools.title: List brains

tools.description: Permanently delete a brain along with all of its pages, sources, connections, and change history. This cannot be undone. Returns id. Requires brainId and authentication.
tools.name: brains_remove
tools.title: Delete a brain

tools.description: Generate this brain's daily brief immediately instead of waiting for its scheduled run. Returns the brief content once generation completes. Returns pageId, slug. Requires brainId and authentication.
tools.name: brains_run_brief
tools.title: Run the daily brief

tools.description: Aggregate counts for a single brain — pages, sources, connections, and unacknowledged changes. Useful for dashboard headline numbers. Returns agentCount, archivedPageCount, bucketCounts. Requires brainId and authentication.
tools.name: brains_stats
tools.title: Brain stats

tools.description: Update a brain's mutable fields, such as its name or description. Omitted fields are left unchanged. Returns briefSettings, createdAt, description. Requires brainId, body and authentication.
tools.name: brains_update
tools.title: Update a brain

tools.description: Update the daily-brief schedule and delivery settings for a brain, including whether briefs are enabled and what time they are generated. Returns briefSettings, createdAt, description. Requires brainId, body and authentication.

enabled.description: Generate a daily brief for this brain

hourLocal.description: Local-time hour the brief should fire

tools.name: brains_update_brief_settings
tools.title: Update brief settings

tools.description: Push a single item into a brain for ingestion. Accepts notes, URLs, raw text, chat transcripts, and PDF/DOCX/PPTX documents. Capture is asynchronous: this returns an ingest source whose `status` you can poll or receive via webhook. Returns affectedPageIds, attempts, brainId. Requires brainId, body and authentication.

bucket.description: Bucket hint for the resulting page(s)

content.description: Raw textual content of the capture

fetchUrl.description: URL the service fetches and extracts instead of inlined content. Extraction is driven by `kind`: file -> parse PDF, Word, PPTX, HTML, or UTF-8 text; url -> scrape web page; transcript -> transcribe audio. Legacy .ppt and other unsupported binary formats are rejected. No cloud credentials needed.

fileName.description: Original filename hint for `fetchUrl` extraction, including its extension

label.description: Short title / filename / URL for display

mimeType.description: MIME type hint for `fetchUrl` extraction (for example application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation)

originRef.description: Origin URL / external id, also used as the idempotency key for dedup

tools.name: captures_capture
tools.title: Push a capture

tools.description: Push many captures in a single request. Each item is processed independently, so a malformed entry fails on its own without rejecting the whole batch. Returns ingested, sources. Requires brainId, body and authentication.

bucket.description: Bucket hint for the resulting page(s)

content.description: Raw textual content of the capture

fetchUrl.description: URL the service fetches and extracts instead of inlined content. Extraction is driven by `kind`: file -> parse PDF, Word, PPTX, HTML, or UTF-8 text; url -> scrape web page; transcript -> transcribe audio. Legacy .ppt and other unsupported binary formats are rejected. No cloud credentials needed.

fileName.description: Original filename hint for `fetchUrl` extraction, including its extension

label.description: Short title / filename / URL for display

mimeType.description: MIME type hint for `fetchUrl` extraction (for example application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation)

originRef.description: Origin URL / external id, also used as the idempotency key for dedup

tools.name: captures_capture_batch
tools.title: Push a capture batch

tools.description: Submit a single chat turn for worthiness classification. The service decides whether the turn contains durable knowledge and only captures it if so, which keeps conversational filler out of the brain. Returns reason, sourceId, worthy. Requires brainId, body and authentication.

agentName.description: Agent display name for classifier context

originRef.description: Idempotency key for the turn (e.g. chat: : )

tools.name: captures_capture_chat_turn
tools.title: Push a chat turn

tools.description: List ingest sources for a brain, optionally filtered by processing status. Use this to surface an ingestion queue or to find sources that failed to compile. Returns items, limit, offset. Requires brainId and authentication.

ids.description: Comma-separated source ids for a targeted lookup (e.g. resolving a page’s source refs regardless of age)

tools.name: captures_list_sources
tools.title: List ingest sources

tools.description: Delete an ingest source. Pages already derived from the source are retained unless you delete them separately. Returns id. Requires brainId, sourceId and authentication.
tools.name: captures_remove_source
tools.title: Delete an ingest source

tools.description: Retry compiling an ingest source that previously failed. Only sources in a failed state can be retried. Returns enqueued, id. Requires brainId, sourceId and authentication.
tools.name: captures_retry_source
tools.title: Retry an ingest source

tools.description: Connect a Slack channel to a brain so it receives brain notifications. Configure which notifications it receives with `updateBinding`. Returns brainId, channelId, channelName. Requires brainId, body and authentication.
tools.name: slack_bind
tools.title: Bind a Slack channel

tools.description: List the channels visible to the Living Brain bot in a Slack installation. `isMember` tells you whether the bot has already been added to the channel. Returns array. Requires brainId, installationId and authentication.

installationId.description: Slack installation id returned by the status endpoint

tools.name: slack_channels
tools.title: List Slack channels

tools.description: Complete a Slack installation by exchanging the `code` and `state` Slack returned to your redirect URL. Returns the new installation ID. Returns brainId, installationId, teamId. Requires brainId, body and authentication.
tools.name: slack_confirm_oauth
tools.title: Confirm Slack OAuth

tools.description: Disconnect a Slack workspace from a brain and remove all of its channel bindings. Returns disconnected. Requires brainId, installationId and authentication.
tools.name: slack_disconnect_installation
tools.title: Disconnect Slack

tools.description: Create a signed Slack OAuth installation URL for a brain. Redirect the user to `authorizationUrl`; Slack sends them back to your redirect URL with a `code` and `state` to pass to `confirmOauth`. The signed state expires at `expiresAt`. Returns authorizationUrl, expiresAt. Requires brainId and authentication.
tools.name: slack_start_oauth
tools.title: Start Slack OAuth

tools.description: Return every Slack workspace installed for a brain along with its channel bindings. Use the installation IDs returned here to list channels or create bindings. Returns bindings, installations. Requires brainId and authentication.
tools.name: slack_status
tools.title: Slack status

tools.description: Disconnect a single Slack channel from a brain. The Slack installation and any other bindings are unaffected. Returns disconnected. Requires brainId, bindingId and authentication.
tools.name: slack_unbind
tools.title: Unbind a Slack channel

tools.description: Update which notifications a bound Slack channel receives — daily briefs, new connections, and page changes. Omitted fields are left unchanged. Returns brainId, channelId, channelName. Requires brainId, bindingId, body and authentication.

notifyBriefs.description: Receive daily summary of brain updates

notifyChanges.description: Get notified when pages are updated with new knowledge

notifyConnections.description: Get notified when strong new connections are discovered

tools.name: slack_update_binding
tools.title: Update a Slack binding

tools.description: Connect a Telegram bot to a brain so messages sent to the bot are captured automatically. Returns botFirstName, botUsername, brainId. Requires brainId, body and authentication.

botToken.description: BotFather bot token to connect to this brain

tools.name: telegram_connect
tools.title: Connect Telegram

tools.description: Disconnect the Telegram bot from a brain. Already-captured messages are retained. Returns disconnected. Requires brainId and authentication.
tools.name: telegram_disconnect
tools.title: Disconnect Telegram

tools.description: Return the current Telegram bot connection status for a brain, including the connected bot's username when one is linked. Returns botFirstName, botUsername, brainId. Requires brainId and authentication.
tools.name: telegram_status
tools.title: Telegram status

tools.description: Register a webhook endpoint and receive its signing secret. The secret is returned only on creation — store it immediately, as it cannot be retrieved again. Returns active, createdAt, events. Requires body and authentication.

events.description: Event types to subscribe to; empty = all

secret.description: Signing secret to use for this subscription. When omitted a random secret is generated and returned once. Hosts that verify deliveries against a pre-configured secret (e.g. an env var) should pass it here so signatures match. Write-only: never returned on reads.

url.description: HTTPS endpoint to deliver events to

tools.name: webhooks_create
tools.title: Register a webhook

tools.description: List all webhook subscriptions for the calling subject. Signing secrets are not included. Returns array. Requires authentication.
tools.name: webhooks_list
tools.title: List webhooks

tools.description: Delete a webhook subscription. Deliveries stop immediately. Returns id. Requires id and authentication.
tools.name: webhooks_remove
tools.title: Delete a webhook

tools.description: Update a webhook subscription's URL or subscribed event types. The signing secret is unchanged. Returns active, createdAt, events. Requires id, body and authentication.

active.description: Set false to pause deliveries without deleting the subscription.

events.description: New event list. Replaces the existing subscription set. Omit to leave unchanged.

url.description: New delivery URL. Omit to leave unchanged.

tools.name: webhooks_update
tools.title: Update a webhook

tools.description: Acknowledge every outstanding change event in one call, and return how many were cleared. Returns acked. Requires brainId and authentication.
tools.name: workspace_ack_all
tools.title: Acknowledge all

tools.description: Acknowledge a single change event, removing it from unacknowledged views. Returns ackedAt, action, brainId. Requires brainId, changeId and authentication.
tools.name: workspace_ack_change
tools.title: Acknowledge a change

tools.description: Dismiss a connection so it stops appearing in unacknowledged views. The connection itself is preserved. Returns ackedAt, brainId, createdAt. Requires brainId, connectionId and authentication.
tools.name: workspace_ack_connection
tools.title: Dismiss a connection

tools.description: Archive a page. Archived pages are hidden from lists and search until restored, but their content, versions, and connections are kept. Use `restore` to bring the page back. Returns archived, backlinks, body. Requires brainId, slug and authentication.
tools.name: workspace_archive
tools.title: Archive a page

tools.description: Return per-bucket page counts for the brain — the fastest way to render bucket navigation with badges. Returns dictionary. Requires brainId and authentication.
tools.name: workspace_buckets
tools.title: Per-bucket page counts

tools.description: List change-feed events with offset pagination. This is the primary way to sync an external system: poll with `since`, or filter to `unackedOnly` to build an inbox. Returns items, limit, offset. Requires brainId and authentication.
tools.name: workspace_changes
tools.title: List change-feed events

tools.description: Permanently delete a page and every record that depends on it, including its versions and connections. This cannot be undone. Returns deleted, pageId, slug. Requires brainId, slug, permanent and authentication.
tools.name: workspace_delete_permanently
tools.title: Delete a page

tools.description: Manually overwrite a page's content. This creates a new version, so the previous content stays retrievable through the version history. Returns archived, backlinks, body. Requires brainId, slug, body and authentication.

body.description: New page content. Replaces the existing body and creates a new version.

summary.description: Short generated summary of the content.

tools.name: workspace_edit_content
tools.title: Edit page content

tools.description: Export the entire brain as a single markdown bundle, suitable for backup or for handing to another tool. Returns brainId, markdown. Requires brainId and authentication.
tools.name: workspace_export_markdown
tools.title: Export as markdown

tools.description: Read a single page by slug. This bumps the page's `lastReferencedAt`, which feeds the brain health score — use it when a human or agent actually consumes the content. Returns archived, backlinks, body. Requires brainId, slug and authentication.
tools.name: workspace_get_page
tools.title: Read a page

tools.description: Return the brain profile — the standing directives and context that shape how the brain interprets and organizes new captures. Returns brainId, createdAt, currentProjects. Requires brainId and authentication.
tools.name: workspace_get_profile
tools.title: Get the brain profile

tools.description: Return the brain's health score with its contributing factors and metrics. The score reflects coverage, freshness, and connectedness. Returns brainId, computedAt, freshness. Requires brainId and authentication.
tools.name: workspace_get_score
tools.title: Brain health score

tools.description: Return a renderable subgraph of nodes and edges for visualizing how the brain's pages relate. Use `nodeLimit` to keep the payload small enough to draw. Returns edges, nodes, truncated. Requires brainId and authentication.
tools.name: workspace_graph
tools.title: Connection graph

tools.description: Return a compact index of the brain's top pages, formatted for injection into an LLM prompt. This is the intended way to give an agent working context without sending the whole brain. Returns array. Requires brainId and authentication.
tools.name: workspace_index
tools.title: Prompt index

tools.description: List connections across the whole brain with offset pagination. Filter by strength, or restrict to connections the user has not yet dismissed. Returns items, limit, offset. Requires brainId and authentication.
tools.name: workspace_list_connections
tools.title: List connections

tools.description: List pages in a brain with offset pagination. Filter by bucket or status, and optionally include deprecated pages that are normally hidden. Returns items, limit, offset. Requires brainId and authentication.

includeArchived.description: Include archived pages in the results. Archived pages are hidden from lists and search by default.

tools.name: workspace_list_pages
tools.title: List pages

tools.description: Move a page into a different bucket. Buckets are the brain's top-level organizational grouping. Returns archived, backlinks, body. Requires brainId, slug, body and authentication.

bucket.description: Top-level grouping the page belongs to.

tools.name: workspace_move_bucket
tools.title: Move a page

tools.description: List the connections attached to a single page, with the related page inlined on each connection. Returns items, pageId. Requires brainId, slug and authentication.
tools.name: workspace_page_connections
tools.title: Connections for a page

tools.description: List a page's version history, newest first. Every content edit and automated recompile produces a version. Returns array. Requires brainId, slug and authentication.
tools.name: workspace_page_versions
tools.title: Page version history

tools.description: Pin or unpin a page. Pinned pages are prioritized in the prompt index and are exempt from deprecation. Returns archived, backlinks, body. Requires brainId, slug, body and authentication.
tools.name: workspace_pin
tools.title: Pin or unpin a page

tools.description: Suggest profile fields inferred from what the brain already contains. Best-effort: returns an empty set when there is not yet enough signal. Returns brainId, suggestions. Requires brainId and authentication.
tools.name: workspace_profile_suggestions
tools.title: Profile suggestions

tools.description: Recover a deprecated page and return it to active status. Returns archived, backlinks, body. Requires brainId, slug and authentication.
tools.name: workspace_recover
tools.title: Recover a page

tools.description: Rename a page's title and slug. Existing connections follow the page, but any external references to the old slug will break. Returns archived, backlinks, body. Requires brainId, slug, body and authentication.

newSlug.description: New URL-safe slug. External references to the old slug will stop resolving.

tools.name: workspace_rename
tools.title: Rename a page

tools.description: Resolve a contested page. A page becomes contested when newly captured material contradicts what the page already asserts; resolving records which version wins. Returns archived, backlinks, body. Requires brainId, slug, body and authentication.
tools.name: workspace_resolve
tools.title: Resolve a page

tools.description: Restore an archived page and return it to active status, so it reappears in lists and search. Returns archived, backlinks, body. Requires brainId, slug and authentication.
tools.name: workspace_restore
tools.title: Restore a page

tools.description: Legacy alias for recovering a deprecated page. Prefer `recover` in new code; this endpoint is retained for backwards compatibility. Returns archived, backlinks, body. Requires brainId, slug and authentication.
tools.name: workspace_reviewed
tools.title: Recover a page (legacy)

tools.description: Return the score trend over a time range, including the delta versus the start of the period. Returns brainId, delta, items. Requires brainId and authentication.
tools.name: workspace_score_history
tools.title: Score trend history

tools.description: Return concrete, ranked suggestions for raising the brain's health score, derived from whichever factors are currently weakest. Returns brainId, computedAt, generatedBy. Requires brainId and authentication.
tools.name: workspace_score_suggestions
tools.title: Score suggestions

tools.description: Search pages using combined semantic and keyword matching. Results are ranked by relevance and include a snippet showing why each page matched. Returns array. Requires brainId, body and authentication.
tools.name: workspace_search_pages
tools.title: Search pages

tools.description: Update the brain profile's directives. These take effect on subsequent captures, not retroactively. Returns brainId, createdAt, currentProjects. Requires brainId, body and authentication.

currentProjects.description: Projects in flight. Omit to leave unchanged.

challengeAssumptions.description: Challenge the user's assumptions before agreeing

flagContradictions.description: Flag contradictions with earlier saved beliefs

preferVaultContext.description: Answer from vault context, not generically

focus.description: Current focus. Omit to leave unchanged.

goals.description: Current goals. Omit to leave unchanged.

stuckOn.description: Known blockers. Omit to leave unchanged.

vaultOrganization.description: Organization preference. Omit to leave unchanged.

whatTheyDo.description: What the subject works on. Omit to leave unchanged.

whoTheyAre.description: Who the subject is. Omit to leave unchanged.
